nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized additive model for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS) normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: “By applying normative modeling with the generalized additive model for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS), we captured the nonlinear trajectories of the developing functional gradient”

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Principal functional connectivity gradient (cortical hierarchy) / gradient values.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: “The principal functional connectivity gradient representing cortical hierarchy was estimated using diffusion map embedding.”

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Normative modeling based on age and the interaction between age and sex.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: “region-wise normative modeling of gradient values based on age and the interaction between age and sex”
